findings.detail: The 406.514 million SLP II look-through investment total is counted in addition to the consolidated 1,815.082 million schedule total.

rationale: Class 3 anchor triangulation is decisive. The filing reports total investments of 1,815.082 million and total assets of 2,089.533 million, while extracted holdings are 2,221.596 million. The extracted holdings exceed the schedule total by exactly 406.514 million, which is the separately disclosed SLP II total investments amount at table 49 row 3. This shows that look-through investments were counted in addition to the consolidated investment schedule, causing the E02 holdings-to-assets ratio failure. Residual risk is limited to the precise parser path that admitted the look-through rows; the aggregate defect and duplicated amount are source-grounded.
